summary: @phb256 Say Yes. I am finalizing the editorial team now. Hoping to publish two issues a year just so we can allow good systems to emerge and the bad to die off. Thinking editors do two articles every issue. Really more a conversation than a review.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @phb256 Say Yes. I am finalizing the editorial team now. Hoping to publish two issues a year just so we can allow good systems to emerge and the bad to die off. Thinking editors do two articles every issue. Really more a conversation than a review.
